First Kiwi restaurant opened in Porirua in 1976

caption:
Maccas joins the Warriors.

McDonald's New Zealand is the One NZ Warriors' new restaurant partner on a three-year deal. The golden arches go on the shorts of all six Warriors teams, from the NRL and NRLW sides down through the pathway grades. It lands in McDonald's 50th year in New Zealand.

Also on the board: IBM x USTA, Mimosa Homes x Melbourne Stars and Geely x Canterbury-Bankstown Bulldogs.
